project_status: Completed concept presentation: two exploratory conversations, illustrative scenario analysis, service blueprint and interactive prototype; no measured service impact

sources.title: Restaurant worker · exploratory conversation
sources.finding: Scheduled finish 23:00; cleaning often extends departure to 23:25–23:40. Bus followed by approximately 15 minutes walking. Missing the bus means a long wait. A colleague’s lift helps when shifts align.
sources.limitation: One participant’s account, supplied as a paraphrased summary. No bus timetable or exact waiting duration was supplied.

sources.title: Retail worker · exploratory conversation
sources.finding: Usually leaves around 22:15 after till closing. Approximately 45-minute journey with one change. Late closing can cause a missed connection. Checking live departures helps.
sources.limitation: One participant’s account, supplied as a paraphrased summary. Scheduled finish time and delay duration were not supplied.

design_change: Hosted pause deprioritised; workplace departure check prioritised

scenario_review.status: Illustrative cases and simulated observations supplied by user; not empirical findings
changes: Explain timing concern separately from cancellation
